chapters.reason: TPO performs iterative sequential revision (search depth) and can scale with search width (parallel sampling) during inference, aligning with the chapter's focus on dynamic test-time compute scaling via iterative processes.

TPO uses textual critiques as rewards for iterative refinement without explicit length penalties, improving alignment through preference optimization, which matches the implicit efficiency methods described.
TPO can incorporate parallel search by generating multiple candidate outputs initially, though its core mechanism is iterative sequential refinement, making this a secondary aspect.
